$comment: HFT-008 _unchecked keep decisions. All public zero-check cores are currently keep=false (module-private). When a decision flips to keep=true, re-publish the affected methods as pub unsafe fn and update this manifest with the decision date and rationale.

decoder_wrap.rationale: unchecked decoder core; keep=false → private, only safe try_wrap exposed

decoder_decode.rationale: unchecked decode core (validates ids, skips bounds); keep=false → private, only safe try_decode exposed

encoder_wrap.rationale: unchecked body-only encode core; keep=false → private, only safe try_wrap exposed

encoder_wrap_and_apply_header.rationale: unchecked full-frame encode+header core; keep=false → private, only safe try_wrap_and_apply_header exposed

read_bytes_unchecked.rationale: all accessors use the checked read_bytes; unchecked variant is internal only

write_bytes_unchecked.rationale: all setters use the checked write_bytes; unchecked variant is internal only
